videos.title: It's still way too hard to switch phones
videos.description:
How much smartphone is too much smartphone? Why is it so hard to switch from one phone to another, even in 2026?
And is your smartwatch finally ready to replace your phone, even for a few things? These are the questions you have, and The Verge's Allison Johnson is here to answer them. videos.title: Meet Beni: a two-legged robot companion  #TITW
videos.description:
Beni seemed too good to be true: a two-legged robot companion that can jump, flip, and autonomously film while following you! But I spent hours with the crowdfunded robot, and while its creators have work to do, it's already a seriously fun remote-control toy that can automatically recover from crashes. It's on Kickstarter today for around $600, with an $800 MSRP.

videos.title: We finally have a Trump Phone | The Vergecast Livestream
videos.description:
We've been tracking the Trump Phone for more than a year. We weren't sure it was real, or that it would ever ship — and we were pretty darn sure it wasn't going to be made in America. Whatever the Trump Phone is, though? We finally got our hands on one. Dom Preston joins David to talk about the device, our first impressions, and whether this is could be the best phone of 2026.
